notes: REGENERATED 2026-08-29T21:00Z at 794a9e9b42, superseding the run at 7a64b2a499. Reason: the review amendment pass changed BOTH the report's shape and what the detector sees, so the committed artifact had to come from a run of the amended script rather than the previous one. Shape: summary.by_proximity and summary.correct_node_present gained a 'not_computed' bucket (a cause column that was never MEASURED is now named rather than folded into 'unrelated'/'false'), and summary.suppressed_by_bare_id was added. Detection: bare_id_present no longer treats a digit run joined to another digit run by -:./ as a standalone id, so ISO dates, times, versions and ratios stop suppressing findings.

WHAT THE DETECTION CHANGE ACTUALLY COST, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED. The corpus was read ONCE and classified twice — with the narrowed check and with the previous one restored — so corpus drift is held constant and the delta is attributable. On 27012 rows: narrowed 192 findings / 47 suppressions, previous 191 findings / 48 suppressions. NET +1 FINDING. The recovered edge is reify b7435956-85ba-4eb6-b8ac-9dc4b40f4ce9 on node 'Task 4666', fact 'Case 4666/4400 is a live architectural contradiction, while task 6554 is a single task with open questions downstream of unlanded work.' — the fact is about task 6554, the '4666' in it is half of the compound 'Case 4666/4400', and the previous check read that half as the endpoint naming itself. proximity 'unrelated', correct_node_present true. So the defect the review named was real and its measured magnitude on this corpus is one edge; publishing the magnitude is the point, since a suppression is invisible in every other number here.

THE RESIDUAL SUPPRESSION BOUND, CHARACTERISED. 47 endpoints were still suppressed by the containment backstop and never became findings. Inspected by hand: 17 sit in an explicit reference context ('#N', 'task N') that canonical_labels' precision-over-recall narrowings declined to parse, and 30 are bare digit runs — of which the sampled majority are also genuine references the shared scanner under-reads ('Dependencies 1720', 'tasks 3061 and 3062' where only the first id is scanned, and foreign 'dark_factory:2500' endpoints matched on their bare number by design). The bound is NOT closed further on purpose: narrowing to a reference context means requiring a preceding 'task'/'#', which is a second task-label vocabulary and is what INV-5 / task 3667 forbids. It is instead COUNTED into summary.suppressed_by_bare_id and named in report.json's caveats as the second reason the rate is a LOWER BOUND.

AGREEMENT WITH THE SUPERSEDED RUN (2026-08-27T06:51Z, 7a64b2a499): 192 findings over a 7048 population (2.72%) against 181 over 6961 (2.60%). Of the +11, exactly +1 is the detection change measured above and the other +10 is two days of live-corpus growth — scanned 26674 -> 27012 (dark_factory 11418 -> 11551 rows and 1424 -> 1447 task nodes; reify 15256 -> 15461 and 2111 -> 2129). 179 of the 181 prior (edge_uuid, end) identities are still present; the 2 absent ones are edges no longer live in a continuously-written graph, not detector regressions. Both predicted families persist: reify 'Task 6165' (6) and dark_factory 'Task 430' (5).

DETERMINISM, RE-MEASURED FOR THIS RUN: two snapshots four minutes apart (20:56Z and 21:00Z, same sha) reproduced EVERY published value bit for bit — scanned 27012, population 7048, unverifiable 311, findings 192, suppressed_by_bare_id 47, the identical set of 192 (edge_uuid, end) identities, and identical by_graph / by_end / by_proximity / correct_node_present breakdowns. Only swept_at differs. As before this is a stability observation over nearby snapshots, NOT a guarantee: both graphs are written to continuously (see the LIVE CORPUS caveat in report.json).

CAUSE EVIDENCE, RE-MEASURED ON THIS RUN: 114/192 (59%) of mis-bound endpoint ids fall in the near-miss proximity buckets (one_digit_diff 106, prefix 8, similar 0) against a chance baseline near zero over 1447 + 2129 task-shaped nodes; and correct_node_present is true for 113/192 (59%), meaning the node the fact actually names ALREADY EXISTS in that graph in the majority of cases. Both reproduce the planning measurement (62.5% and 64%) and the superseded run (58% and 61%) within the movement of a live corpus. The second is the load-bearing one: this is predominantly ACTIVE mis-resolution, not a missing-node coverage gap. not_computed is 0 in both breakdowns, which is now an assertable fact rather than an assumption — every finding reached the report enriched.

THE CANONICAL SPECIMEN IS NOT REPRESENTATIVE, and the report carries both counts so that is visible: reify node 'Task 6164' does NOT exist, which puts the Task 6165 family in the 41% minority where the correct node is absent. A reader generalizing from that family alone would reach the wrong diagnosis.

BOTH ENDS ARE REPRESENTED: 120 subject-end and 72 object-end findings. The object-end population is what a subject-only detector — the one the task description proposes — would have missed entirely, and specimen 8a51e13b is in it.

report.json is byte-for-byte the script's stdout. cmp-verified against the captured stream for THIS run: IDENTICAL, not merely equal modulo whitespace. It was neither pretty-printed nor hand-edited. All logging went to stderr.

PAGINATION IS LOAD-BEARING HERE AND THE RUN PROVES IT: reify returned 15461 live RELATES_TO rows through _paged_ro_query. The server's RESULTSET_SIZE is 10000, so an unpaginated MATCH — the shape audit_unverified_completion_claims.py uses, correctly, for its smaller population — would have returned exactly 10000 of them silently, and every denominator in this report would be wrong. This is why EdgeReader routes both reads through the shared paged primitive and why truncated_by is a first-class report key rather than a footnote. All four paged reads (nodes + edges, per graph) reported complete=True and report.json's truncated_by is null.

SCOPE, STATED IN THE ARTIFACT ITSELF: report.json's known_gaps names the two sub-classes this Class-A detector provably does not cover (direction-reversal, specimens 1cf19488 / 01e3ff5d; and fact-contradicts-source-episode, specimen 993a9a7b) together with the measured refutation of the cheap leftmost-id direction heuristic. So 'this run found no reversals' cannot be read as 'the corpus holds no reversals'.

INVARIANT HELD: this sweep invalidated nothing, reassigned nothing and deleted nothing. Every edge the report names is left exactly as it is, for human adjudication. The script has no --apply/--invalidate/--delete/--repair/--reassign path, an absence pinned by TestReadOnlyByConstruction (whose forbidden-call set deliberately includes reassign_edge and merge_entities, the lossless remediation primitives for THIS defect class), and it reads the graph exclusively over GRAPH.RO_QUERY, where read-only is server-enforced. As of this run that guarantee is also CHECKED rather than merely asserted: _read hands _paged_ro_query a _ReadOnlyGraphProxy that resolves each primitive it is asked for to the FalkorDB command it would issue and raises on anything but GRAPH.RO_QUERY. The previous guard compared a module constant against itself and could never fire.
